blurb: Bristol Oaks offers a challenging and enjoyable golf course for all skill levels with four sets of tees, water hazards on three holes, and mature tree-lined fairways. Practice facilities include a grass lighted driving range, a large chipping area, and a putting green. The club also hosts events such as outdoor yoga sessions with wine.
